name: Demidoff Corp
description:
About This Game

Welcome to the mystical world of Ural folk tales, where you must uncover the secrets held within Demidov’s Tower. Explore the historical Ural, venture deep into the icy mining tunnels, dive into mysterious lakes, and make your way through dense forests.

They say that the ancient evil has awoken within the Ural mountains. While Demidov’s factories continue to emit smoke day and night, a magical affliction is beginning to spread throughout the region: animals go wild and lose their minds, and the mines are crawling with unspeakable creatures that seem to have sprung out right from the depths of the mountains.

You play as a fluffy retired royal agent who sets off on an urgent mission to the ends of the earth to investigate what is going on in Demidov’s estates and report the whole truth to the Tsar. But anyone who sticks their nose into other people’s secrets risks becoming part of a mystery themselves.

Explore every corner of the mythical Ural. You will find yourself in a gloomy mine, but the way out is hidden even deeper… Descend into mysterious caves, swim across underground lakes, and wander along forest trails and village streets. And if fate is on your side, you may make your way to the magnificent Malachite Palace and take a peek inside Demidov’s Tower.

Be on your guard: the creatures that good fairy tales prefer not to mention are already waiting for you in the forests and dungeons. You’ll have to find a way to deal with each powerful foe, because sheer bravado won’t be enough.

On your quest to unravel the mystery, you’ll encounter many beasts driven wild by a mysterious affliction. Keep your eyes peeled: danger may come from the ground, fall from the sky, or rise from the dark waters.

Not every path will reveal itself on the first try. Harness the magic of the natural elements, master new techniques and skills, and then the paths that were once blocked will open up before you.

Some beasts have hearts of gold. Listen to the tales told by the locals, but don’t forget the Tsar’s order that brought you here. Complete quests, study ancient manuscripts, and piece together the true story of Demidov, ancient magic, and the hidden evil lurking in the copper veins of the Ural mountains.
short_desc: Demidoff Corp is an atmospheric 2D metroidvania based on Ural folk tales. Explore mystical lands, fight ancient creatures, unlock new abilities, and uncover Demidov’s secret to put an end to the evil that has awoken in the depths of the Ural mountains.
